Sun & Moon series · TEU

Team Up

Released February 1, 2019 · 198 cards

Expanded

Team Up is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on February 1, 2019. Its main set has 181 cards, plus 17 secret rares numbered beyond the set (198 in total). It includes 155 Pokémon, 43 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

47 illustrators worked on Team Up. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (32), Ken Sugimori (14), Megumi Mizutani (7), Anesaki Dynamic (6), Ayaka Yoshida (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Kouki Saitou (6), Misa Tsutsui (6).
